messages.subject: Re: error in target runner
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The instance file is the 4th parameter passed to target-runner, so you need to read the filename from argv[4] if target-runner is a compiled C file. But this may not be the only error. Your target-runner does not seem to be printing anything at all to the screen.

To help you, I have created a dummy example here: https://github.com/MLopez-Ibanez/irace/tree/master/inst/examples/target-runner-c

I hope that helps!

Manuel.
